rung_purposes.purpose: Load pressure test setpoints and alarm limits into data registers
Detect pack pressure sensor wire break condition
Detect pack overpressure condition and latch alarm
Detect loss of supply air during active test cycle
Reset latched alarms when fault reset pushbutton is pressed
Aggregate common faults and energise station fault beacon
Enable manual pack venting in manual mode via pushbutton
Start ST20 automatic cycle when pallet is detected in position
Advance to Step 2 (Fill) once clamp closed limit is confirmed
Run fill timeout timer during Step 2
Latch fill timeout alarm if target pressure is not met in time
Advance to Step 3 (Stabilise) once target fill pressure is reached
Run stabilisation timer during Step 3
Capture initial test pressure reading on test window start
Advance to Step 4 (Test) upon stabilisation timer completion
Run leak test evaluation window timer during Step 4
Capture final pressure and calculate pressure decay drop
Compare pressure drop against limit and latch Pass or Fail result
Advance to Step 5 (Vent) once test window completes
Abort sequence and force Step 5 vent on common fault
Run vent timer during Step 5
Advance to Step 6 (Unclamp) when vented below residual limit
Advance to Step 7 (Complete) once clamp open limit switch makes
Clear cycle busy and complete flags after pallet departs
Energise clamp close solenoid during clamping, test, and vent steps
Energise fill valve during Step 2 if station is fault-free
Open vent valve during Step 5 or pack overpressure condition
Signal Pass or Fail status to line controller during Step 7
End of ladder logic program scan
